node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 positive-coordinate remaining-route payment
node.statement: Every positive-coordinate route left by the exact 13-route residual workboard, except the already proved 433-1a to O0b and 433-1b to O0a routes, is empty or has a printed exact distinct-affine-slope payment in the active first-match ledger. The eleven obligations are 442-0a to O0b/O1b/O1d, 442-1b to O0a/O0b, 433-0 to O0a/O0b/O1b/O1c/O1d, and 433-1b to O0b. The theorem outputs a literal integer U_remaining equal to the sum of the disjoint route payments and retains the same received-line owner, exact multiplicity, and add-back chronology.
node.falsifier: A guarded packet on any of the eleven routes, or a slope payment that loses owner identity, multiplicity, or first-match chronology.
